title: Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) Training Notes: Discount Horizon of Early-Retired Distribution-Margin Rows
content:
# Discount Horizon of Early-Retired Distribution-Margin Rows

*Training notes — Capital Credits (Patronage Capital), discounted early retirement.*

**The rule.** The early discount horizon is counted by the row's distance from rotation, measured as the whole years from the calendar year of the retirement to its allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years, never fewer than zero:

- a row at least **10** whole years from rotation is discounted over those whole years less the full calendar months already elapsed in the year of the retirement, taken in twelfths of a year;
- a row no more than **2** whole years from rotation is not discounted at all — it is paid at full value;
- any other row (3 to 9 whole years from rotation) is discounted over its whole years.

## Questions answered

**What are the "full calendar months already elapsed in the year of the retirement"?** The whole months from January 1 of the year of the retirement up to the date the row is booked. A row booked on any day in October has 9 full months elapsed (January through September); a row booked in January has none.

**How is the twelfth taken?** The months elapsed are divided by twelve and the result is taken from the whole years: 9 months is three quarters of a year.

**Does a row exactly 10 years from rotation take the month reduction?** Yes; 10 is "at least 10".

**Is a row exactly 2 years from rotation discounted?** No; 2 is "no more than 2", so it is paid at full value.

## Horizon table for a row booked in October (hypothetical, 9 months elapsed)

| Whole years from rotation | Horizon used for the discount |
|---|---|
| 12 | 11.25 years (12 less 9 twelfths) |
| 10 | 9.25 years |
| 9 | 9 years |
| 3 | 3 years |
| 2 | none — full value |
| 0 | none — full value |

For a row booked in January (no full month elapsed), a row 12 whole years from rotation is discounted over 12 years.
